metadata.title: Teaching & Supervision
metadata.description: Learning AI through clear explanations, practical experiments and research-led projects.
metadata.sourceNote: Academic record supplied by Dandan Zhang, 30 October 2026; current roles cross-checked against institutional and course pages.

intro: My teaching connects the foundations of machine learning with hands-on experimentation in robotics and bioengineering. I lead postgraduate Deep Learning teaching at Imperial and support students from different disciplinary backgrounds through practical laboratories, research projects and academic advising.

data.description: Postgraduate elective at FHEQ Level 7: 5 ECTS / 10 CATS. Responsibilities include curriculum design, assessment, practical teaching and coordination of the teaching team.
details: The 2024–2025 delivery included 16 lecture hours, nine practical laboratory hours and mini-project supervision.
Approximate annual cohorts: 20–25 students in 2024–2025; 30–35 in 2025–2026; 75–80 in 2026–2027.

learning.title: From foundations to independent experiments
learning.description: The teaching materials connect mathematical ideas to visual explanations, code and concrete examples. The sequence below describes the learning approach guiding the current resource development.

steps.title: Understand
steps.description: Build intuition for data, neural networks, optimisation and generalisation.

steps.title: Implement
steps.description: Connect CNNs, ResNets, RNNs, attention and Transformers to working code.

steps.title: Experiment
steps.description: Explore generative models and applications through controlled practical examples.
steps.detail: Change one factor at a time.

steps.title: Evaluate
steps.description: Compare results, analyse failure cases and communicate reproducible findings.

themes.name: Visual learning
themes.description: CNNs, residual learning and interpretation of image features.

themes.name: Sequences and attention
themes.description: RNNs, sequence-to-sequence models, attention and Transformers.

themes.name: Generative AI
themes.description: GANs, diffusion models and the connection between models and generated data.

themes.name: Practical research skills
themes.description: Google Colab, local VS Code/Jupyter workflows, GPU experiments and GitHub code management.

development.title: Teaching resources in development
development.description: Expanded illustrated lecture notes, guided practical examples and a personalised digital teaching assistant are being developed to support students with different starting points. These activities are in development; public resource links will be added when available.

supervision.title: Research supervision & researcher development
supervision.description: Supervision spans robotics, artificial intelligence and bioengineering across MRes, MSc, integrated MEng and doctoral programmes. Mentoring combines individual research meetings, group discussion and peer learning with experimental design, reproducible evaluation, writing, peer review and career planning.

projects.name: SARL

projects.name: ADM-DP

projects.name: TactEx

supervision.projectsNote: These master’s projects led to first-author ICRA 2026 papers. Each researcher was co-supervised with Lan Wei, with Dandan Zhang as corresponding author.
